## Summary
Phase 87 wire rename, Batch 1 part 1 (ADR-337). REST paths and wire records owned by `project/`, `member/`, `projecttemplate/`, `setupstatus/` move to matter/client vocabulary. Entities, services, repositories, events and controller class names are unchanged. No `@JsonProperty` / `@JsonAlias`, no migration, ADR-342 storage literals (`"PROJECT"`, `"project"`) untouched.

Backend only. The frontend still calls the old paths until **607D** — this is the planned split per the Phase 87 breakdown (backend 404s old paths, no redirect, §12.4.7).

## Rename map
**Paths**
| Old | New |
|---|---|
| `/api/projects` (GET, POST) | `/api/matters` |
| `/api/projects/{id}` (GET/PUT/DELETE) | `/api/matters/{matterId}` |
| `/api/projects/{id}/{archive,complete,reopen,field-groups,tags,setup-status,unbilled-summary,upcoming-deadlines}` | `/api/matters/{matterId}/…` |
| `/api/projects/{projectId}/members[/{memberId}[/role]]` | `/api/matters/{matterId}/members…` |
| `/api/project-templates/**` | `/api/matter-templates/**` |
| `/api/project-templates/from-project/{projectId}` | `/api/matter-templates/from-matter/{matterId}` |
| `/api/project-templates/{id}/required-customer-fields` | `/api/matter-templates/{id}/required-client-fields` |

**Records**
| Old | New | Components |
|---|---|---|
| `ProjectController.ProjectResponse` (nested) | `project/dto/MatterResponse` (top-level) | `customerId→clientId`, `projectRole→matterRole` |
| `ProjectController.CreateProjectRequest` / `UpdateProjectRequest` | `CreateMatterRequest` / `UpdateMatterRequest` | `customerId→clientId` |
| `ProjectController.CompleteProjectRequest` | `CompleteMatterRequest` | — |
| `project.ProjectWithRole` | `project.MatterWithRole` | `project→matter`, `projectRole→matterRole` |
| `project.ProjectUpcomingDeadline` | `project.MatterUpcomingDeadline` | — |
| `ProjectMemberController.ProjectMemberResponse` | `MatterMemberResponse` | `projectRole→matterRole` |
| `projecttemplate.dto.ProjectTemplateResponse` | `MatterTemplateResponse` | `sourceProjectId→sourceMatterId` |
| `projecttemplate.dto.SaveFromProjectRequest` | `SaveFromMatterRequest` | — |
| `projecttemplate.dto.InstantiateTemplateRequest` | (same) | `customerId→clientId`, `projectLeadMemberId→matterLeadMemberId` |
| `setupstatus.ProjectSetupStatus` | `MatterSetupStatus` | `projectId→matterId`, `customerAssigned→clientAssigned` |
| `setupstatus.ProjectUnbilledBreakdown` | `MatterUnbilledBreakdown` | `projectId→matterId`, `projectName→matterName` |
| `setupstatus.UnbilledTimeSummary` | (same) | `byProject→byMatter` |

JPQL `SELECT new …project.ProjectWithRole(` constructor expressions in `ProjectRepository` updated to `MatterWithRole` (string, not compiler-checked — validated by context start in Tier 2).

## Ratchet
`backend/src/test/resources/wire/batch1-known-offenders.txt`: **109 → 55 entries** (54 lines deleted: 26 `DTO` + 28 `ROUTE`; deletions only). `WireVocabularyContractTest.java` byte-identical to `main`. Kept: `MissingFieldSummary#customerCount` (608A) and every 607C/608/609 `ROUTE` line.

## Decisions
- **D0** — ratchet-forced component renames applied: `MatterWithRole.matter`, `MatterTemplateResponse.sourceMatterId`, `MatterSetupStatus.clientAssigned`.
- **D1** — full clean of request records: `CreateMatterRequest`/`UpdateMatterRequest{clientId}`, `CompleteMatterRequest`, `SaveFromMatterRequest`, `InstantiateTemplateRequest{clientId, matterLeadMemberId}`.
- **D2** — `?customerId=` query params on `GET /api/matters` and `GET /api/matter-templates/{id}/prerequisite-check` left unchanged.
- **D3** — test class names unchanged (named after the unchanged entity/service).
- **D4** — `MatterMemberResponse`: only `matterRole` renamed (no `projectId`/`matterId` component exists).

## Downstream impact for 607D (frontend must follow)
- **Paths**: all of the above.
- **Matter responses** (every `ProjectController` endpoint + `POST /api/matter-templates/{id}/instantiate`): `customerId→clientId`, `projectRole→matterRole`.
- **Member list**: `projectRole→matterRole`.
- **Template response**: `sourceProjectId→sourceMatterId`.
- **Setup status**: `projectId→matterId`, `customerAssigned→clientAssigned`.
- **Unbilled summary**: `byProject→byMatter`, items `projectId→matterId`, `projectName→matterName` — this **also changes `GET /api/customers/{id}/unbilled-summary`** (shared `UnbilledTimeSummary` record; that path itself is unchanged).
- **Request bodies**: `POST /api/matters` and `PUT /api/matters/{matterId}` send `clientId` (not `customerId`); instantiate body sends `clientId` and `matterLeadMemberId`. Jackson ignores unknown properties, so an un-migrated `customerId` body field is silently dropped (no 400).
- **Unchanged**: `?customerId=` query params (D2).

## Non-scope
- Frontend, portal, `compose/seed`, `scripts/regression-test.sh`, Playwright (607D/E/F).
- `/api/projects/{projectId}/{activity,comments,budget,tasks,documents,health,task-summary,member-hours}` (607C); `customer/**`, `setupstatus/CustomerReadiness`, correspondence, information-requests (608); expenses, time entries, time-summary, profitability, adverse-parties, portal (609).
- MCP DTOs (`McpMatterDto`, `McpMatterListItem`) and `tool-contract.json` — unchanged. The only `mcp/` edits are 3 accessor call sites (`withRole.matter()/matterRole()`, `p.clientId()`).
- Entity/service/repository/event names; migrations.

Forced call-site edits outside the four packages: `dashboard/DashboardService` (MatterWithRole import/accessor), `mcp/tool/MatterTools`, `mcp/resource/MatterResource`. Tests: 80 files path-rewritten (438 lines, incl. `testutil/TestEntityHelper`) by a scoped classifier script, plus hand edits of JSON assertions/bodies/accessors. 607B.4 (REST-Docs/fixtures): no-op — none in scope.

## Test plan
- [x] Tier 1: `./mvnw compile test-compile` clean (after `spotless:apply`).
- [x] Tier 2a — four packages + contract/pin tests (54 classes, incl. `WireVocabularyContractTest`, `EntityTypeLiteralStabilityTest`, `McpToolContractTest`, `McpReadOnlyRegistryTest`, `McpHandshakeIntegrationTest`, `AuditEventTypeRegistryTest`, `LayerDependencyRulesTest`): `Tests run: 446, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0`.
- [x] Tier 2b — cross-package edited tests + forced-edit consumers (67 classes): `Tests run: 617, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0`.
- [x] Every edited test class was in Tier 2a/2b (only `TestEntityHelper`, a helper, is not itself a test class).
- [x] Verification greps: no 607B legacy path left in main; test classifier shows only 607C (199) / 608 (13) / 609 (57) buckets, unchanged from baseline; no stale `projectRole`/`sourceProjectId`/`customerAssigned`/`byProject` JSON assertions; no `@JsonProperty`/`@JsonAlias`; frozen tests and `tool-contract.json` untouched; MCP diff = 3 code lines; baseline diff = deletions only.
- [ ] Full `./mvnw verify` — owned by the orchestrator + Backend CI (not run by the builder).
